title: Job candidates
description: Jobs a person repeats across sessions, proposed as microservices, most repeated first.

minSessions.description: Fewest known sessions a candidate must cite.

minObjects.description: Fewest different objects a candidate's citations must name.

slug.description: Short name for the job, usable as a microservice name.

job.description: The task, in the words the person would ask for it.

why.description: What in the sessions shows the repetition.

citations.description: Sessions that show the job, one entry per session.

object.description: What the job acted on, as a word found in that session's prompts or project.

coveredBy.description: The catalog microservice, skill, or external service that already does the job, or null.

reuses.description: Catalog atoms the job would be built from.

missing.description: Atoms the job needs that the catalog does not have.

noun.description: The one noun the atom owns.

dropped.description: Candidates the model proposed that failed a check.

model.description: The model that proposed the candidates.

costUsd.description: Model spend of this call. Zero on a cache hit.
